projects.title: Reliable campaign delivery
projects.problem: A legacy PHP messaging service was losing messages and emails.
projects.contribution: Took ownership, rewrote the service in Laravel, and led incremental CRM modernization.
decisions: Redis-backed queues and asynchronous processing, with idempotency keys to prevent duplicate sends.
Twilio, Plivo and Telnyx for SMS; SendGrid and SES for email. CloudWatch for delivery monitoring.
Laravel APIs and Vue/Nuxt for the CRM; MySQL for operations and Redshift for campaign analytics.
projects.outcome: Resolved the reported delivery-loss issues, prevented duplicate sends, and added campaign reporting.
projects.evidence: Professional account; no measured throughput, uptime or cost figures are published.

projects.title: Internal data & developer tooling
projects.problem: Teams needed consistent access to internal data and application quality signals.
projects.contribution: Built and deployed an internal FastAPI API, collectors, repository tooling, and shared libraries.
decisions: OpenAPI documentation for the internal data API; Python/Bash collectors and Strawberry GraphQL for engineering metrics.
Dependency analysis to flag libraries outside quality and security standards.
Terraform-managed Azure deployments, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.
projects.outcome: Teams gained a documented data API and tooling to identify dependency issues across applications.
projects.evidence: Professional account; no adoption counts or measured time savings are published.
